b248fc93-f147-4cdb-833c-8b3c282f32df.title: Hello everyone.…
sentences: Today I want to talk about the weather.
It is a beautiful sunny day in the park.
Many people are walking their dogs and having picnics.
Children are playing on the swings and slides under the old oak tree.
translations: 公园里阳光明媚，天气很好。
孩子们在老橡树下荡秋千、滑滑梯。
